stem:
Yash studies this forest food chain: leaves → caterpillar → small bird → hawk.

Which statement correctly assigns the trophic levels?

options.text: Leaves are at the first trophic level, the caterpillar at the second, the small bird at the third, and the hawk at a later level.
The hawk is at the first trophic level because it is the largest animal in the chain.
The small bird is at the first trophic level because it starts the animal part of the chain.
Every organism in the forest is at the same trophic level because they share one forest.

teacher.key_rationale: Producers (leaves) are first, herbivores (caterpillar) second, small carnivores (small bird) third, and larger carnivores (hawk) later. Size, starting the animal part, or sharing a habitat does not set trophic level.
